final: WITH joined_data AS (SELECT s.pulsepersec, t.equipstatus FROM signals s INNER JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry WHERE s.pulsepersec IS NOT NULL), status_averages AS (SELECT equipstatus, AVG(pulsepersec) as avg_pulse FROM joined_data GROUP BY equipstatus), mean1_calc AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse) as mean1 FROM status_averages), filtered_first AS (SELECT sa.avg_pulse FROM status_averages sa, mean1_calc m1 WHERE sa.avg_pulse > m1.mean1), mean2_calc AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse) as mean2 FROM filtered_first), filtered_second AS (SELECT ff.avg_pulse FROM filtered_first ff, mean2_calc m2 WHERE ff.avg_pulse > m2.mean2), results AS (SELECT AVG(fs.avg_pulse) as final_avg, (SELECT mean1 FROM mean1_calc) as mean1, (SELECT mean2 FROM mean2_calc) as mean2 FROM filtered_second fs) SELECT final_avg, final_avg - mean1 as avg_excess_mean1, final_avg - mean2 as avg_excess_mean2 FROM results
